qualification.details: The minimum eligibility requirement for all departments is a Ph.D. degree with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree, in an appropriate branch, with a very good academic record throughout. The specific bachelor's/ master's degree requirement differs by department. | Biosciences and Bioengineering: Ph.D. plus a 4-year Bachelor's degree, or 5-year integrated Master's in Biotechnology/ Biochemical/ Chemical Engineering/ Bioinformatics/ Biosciences, or 4-year Bachelor's in Engineering/ Technology/ Agricultural/ Pharmaceutical Sciences, or MBBS/ BVSc, or equivalent integrated degrees in Biological, Physical, Chemical, and Data Sciences, Mathematics, or Statistics. Chemical Engineering: Ph.D. plus Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering. Civil Engineering: Ph.D. plus a 4-year Bachelor's degree or 5-year integrated Master's degree in Civil Engineering. Computer Science and Engineering: Ph.D. plus a 4-year Bachelor's degree, or Bachelor's + Master's, or 5-year integrated Master's in Computer Science/ Computer Science and Engineering or a relevant discipline. Design: Ph.D. plus a 4-year Bachelor's degree or 2-year Master's degree or 5-year integrated Master's in Design, Technology, Engineering, Architecture, Management, Fine Arts, Visual Arts, or Physiology (Ergonomics). Electronics and Electrical Engineering: Ph.D. plus a 4-year Bachelor's degree or 5-year integrated Master's in Electrical/ Electronics/ Instrumentation/ Communication/ Telecommunication Engineering. Mechanical Engineering: Ph.D. plus a 4-year Bachelor's degree or 5-year integrated Master's in Mechanical Engineering. Chemistry: Ph.D. plus a Bachelor's and Master's degree, or 5-year integrated Master's in Chemistry/ Chemical Science and Technology. Humanities and Social Science: Ph.D. in the relevant advertised area, with first class or equivalent throughout. Mathematics: Requirement varies by specialization - e.g. Ph.D./ M.Tech./ B.Tech. in Data Science, AI, or Computer Science & Engineering for the ML/ AI track; Ph.D./ Master's/ Bachelor's in Statistics for the Statistics track; Ph.D./ Master's/ Bachelor's in Mathematics for the pure Mathematics track. Physics: Ph.D. plus Bachelor's and Master's degree, or 5-year integrated Master's in Physics/ Applied Physics/ Engineering Physics. School of Business: Ph.D. degree in Management. Mehta Family School of Data Science and AI: Ph.D. in Engineering/ Science relevant to Data Science and AI, plus a 4-year Bachelor's or 5-year integrated Master's in Data Science/ AI, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science and Engineering, or Electronics/ Communication/ Electrical Engineering. School of Energy Science and Engineering: Ph.D. plus a Bachelor's or 5-year integrated Master's in Energy/ Mechanical/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Chemical Engineering. Jyoti and Bhupat Mehta School of Health Sciences and Technology: Ph.D. plus a 4-year Bachelor's in Engineering/ Biotechnology, 4-year BS Programme, 5-year integrated Master's in Engineering, BS(4 years)/ MS(5 years) in Physics/ Maths/ Biological Sciences, B.Pharm, or MBBS (with PhD).

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) has officially released inviting online applications for the recruitment of Assistant Professor Grade I and Grade II across 15 academic departments and schools. The notification contains complete details regarding eligibility criteria, department-wise specializations, educational qualifications, experience requirements, age limit, pay levels, reservation policy, selection process, application procedure, and important instructions. Candidates interested in pursuing a faculty career at IIT Guwahati are advised to read the complete notification carefully before submitting their online application. The official notification is available on the IIT Guwahati website. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal: https:/ / online.iitg.ac.in/ faonline/ Register and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and experience details. Select the Department/ School and area of specialization you wish to apply for. Upload all required certificates and documents in the prescribed format. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for IIT Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026 is 31.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How can I apply for IIT Guwahati Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online only through https://online.iitg.ac.in/faonline/. Hard copy/offline applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification for IIT Guwahati Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree, in an appropriate branch, with a very good academic record throughout, is the minimum qualification. Specific bachelor's/master's degree requirements vary by department.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIT Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should preferably be below 35 years of age as on the date of advertisement, with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for IIT Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee details are not mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay level for Assistant Professor at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor Grade II is placed at 7th CPC Pay Level 10 & 11, while Assistant Professor Grade I is placed at Pay Level 12, based on post-Ph.D. experience.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are there in IIT Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies per department is not mentioned in the official notification. Candidates can apply across 15 departments/schools based on matching specialization and qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one department at IIT Guwahati Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates may apply for a position in more than one Department/School, but a separate application must be submitted for each Department/School.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for IIT Guwahati faculty application?
faq.answer: Candidates need educational qualification certificates, Ph.D. degree, experience certificates (if applicable), category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD, if applicable), and an NOC if currently employed in a Government/Semi-Government organization.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for IIT Guwahati Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates, based on qualification, experience, and departmental requirements, are called for an interview. Meeting eligibility criteria does not guarantee an interview call.
